title: Join native ADD count backing across execution phases
body:
## Summary

Close the count/counter composition handoff from PR2912 and PR2905 for one unchanged native ADD action:

```text
extent preparation: E
then retained marginals R + callback H or native countdowns C
joined count backing <= K + max(E, R + max(C,H))
```

The new `research/selected-add-count-phase-envelope/` package supplies a written source-lifetime proof, authenticated unchanged-source replay, exact receipts, controls and registered tests. The callback allowance requires release before return; clearing alone is insufficient. [Canonical investigation and scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18970664).

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2697 source and retained stream/hosting lineage, Nick Petalas's PR2912 extent and PR2905 countdown results, kumagi's PR2882 action-private interface, and the separate PR2902 payload and Ross Richardson numerical/caller components. Substantial automated assistance was used; evidence is author-checked.

## Evidence

- Before, the 21-cell extent-preparation envelope did not cover the native phase. The joined source execution reaches 30 cells while preserving the complete ADD endpoint. A released H=68 callback peaks at 80; retaining its cleared tapes instead reaches 166 with correct coefficients and payload. Index padding separately reaches 267.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes 70 complete ADD fixtures, including all nine origin basis planes, eight embedded controls and seven test groups. Tests reject a true one-cell-short quota, wrong coefficient implementation, changed executable source and typed receipt corruption; normal/optimized Git-free relocation passes.
- Optimized CPython 3.14 reproduces the same receipt. A separate internal source/weak-reference check corroborates the measurements. Ruff checks pass; repository workflow tests pass 144 tests with seven skips. Committed-byte preflight authenticates all 20 package/input files at `639a340f6d514bbea984923da4df495b1dae42ac`.
- Initial canonical main `475fec190`; refreshed main `5a0dc2c0f` changes no relevant guidance, selected record, inputs or runner. Priority revision five. Final complete metadata overlap covers 493 open PRs, 2116 closed/merged PRs and 1588 Discussion records, with its limits recorded in TASK.json.

Reproduce with `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-add-count-phase-envelope`.

This proves one count-backing component under the stated source/ownership premises. Numerical/program/record composition, total private A, physical reuse, recursive/outer reserve, full selected replay and formal/human review remain separate. No supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. Hosted CI is separate from local checks.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. One new scoped research package.

**Blast radius:** research. The selected frontier, frozen inputs and shared runners are unchanged.
